reason: 呼炉凪来 新宿店 (4.2, 940): 334 reviews published in a single month about 6 months ago, then ~5 per month; many near-identical 'お通しのおでん食べ放題' texts. Burst that has ended.
$comment: One entry per review as far as the newest-sorted scrape reached. pricePerPerson / mealType are the UI-language labels of the guided-dining answers (uiLanguage). No reviewer names, profile ids, URLs or avatars are stored. Owner-reply text is replaced by "#" + a hash of the normalized text (+ " 高評価" when it thanked for a high rating): duplicate and mismatched-thanks checks give the same results, the words are not in the repo.
